cohort: 68 parturient mothers and their newborns (34 normal vaginal delivery, 34 combined analgesia) recruited in Fatemieh Teaching Hospital, Hamadan City, Iran.
finding: The study found no statistically significant difference in oxidative stress biomarkers (TTM, TAC, CAT) in maternal plasma, maternal saliva, or umbilical cord blood samples between deliveries with and without combined analgesia.
mod_finding: No significant difference in oxidative stress markers was observed between normal vaginal delivery and deliveries with combined analgesia.
birth_weight: Newborn birth weight was measured, but specific weight ranges for the cohort are not provided.
